insight: Raised $8M from Qualcomm Ventures in Jan 2026 to build on-device AI for enterprise legal; ~$113M raised in total.
name: SpotDraft
tagline: AI-powered contract lifecycle management for fast-growing teams.
description: SpotDraft is an AI-powered contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform for legal and business teams to create, negotiate, sign, store, and track contracts in one place. Its VerifAI assistant reviews and redlines contracts against your playbook, while workflows, e-signature, a searchable repository, and obligation tracking cover the full lifecycle. Integrates with Microsoft Word, Slack, and Teams.
edge: Covers the whole contract lifecycle — drafting, negotiation, e-sign, repository, and obligation tracking — with AI review (VerifAI), not just point drafting.
cons: Enterprise sales/demo, no public free tier
Heavier than a single-purpose drafting tool
Best fit for in-house legal teams
